messages:
maria: seeing a reproducible p99 spike on small-seq (<=64) models after last night's driver roll. started ~12:40 UTC, affects hosted cluster A
kevin: confirmed on staging too, throughput OK but latency jumps ~2-3x on 1-2 token responses :grimacing:
jasmin: any change to batching heuristics or kv cache policy deployed? I didn't push anything to batcher yesterday
sandeep: infra-bot showed kernel autoselect rollout at 12:30 (Triton autotuner + flashattn opt). linking logs
infra-bot: deploy: kernel-autoselect:v2 -> cluster-A (id: d-87f3), rollout at 2026-03-10T12:28:09Z
eli: attaching a quick perf profile from a repro run on a dev GPU (p4d small seq 64, batch 8)
eli: ```
# sample profiler slice
Kernel chosen: flash_attn_smallseq_fused (autoselect)
Duration: 1.8 ms per token
Fallback kernel (flash_attn_generic): 0.45 ms per token
Occupancy: 28% vs fallback 72%
SM utilization low, high warp divergence
```
maria: whoa that's the opposite of what we'd expect. autoselect picked a slower kernel for small seqs
kevin: looks like Triton autotuner favored a signed-int8-path for memory reasons on that card; perf numbers probably from a different seq distribution when tuning
jasmin: also seeing KV cache churn in logs, eviction rates spiked at same time window, might be interplay with batching/block allocator change
eli: kv metrics snippet: ```
kv_cache_evictions: 412 -> baseline 18
kv_cache_hit_ratio: 0.62 -> baseline 0.98
batcher_avg_batch_size: 3.2 -> baseline 6.1
```
sandeep: noisy neighbor? any colocated training jobs started around then? infra shows a transient GPU memory pressure event from a partner job on node set X
kevin: but the same regression reproduces on isolated dev instance when toggling the kernel policy to autoselect. reproducer attached in thread (short script)
maria: immediate mitigation: rolling back kernel-autoselect:v2 -> set REDWOOD_TRITON_KERNEL_POLICY=legacy on cluster-A. will watch p99. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
infra-bot: rollback started for cluster-A at 2026-03-10T12:53:02Z
perf-bot: post-rollback quick-check: p99 small-seq down from 2100 ms -> 520 ms (baseline 480 ms)
jasmin: long-term action items: 1) add sequence-length aware autotuner tests (small/medium/long) 2) add KV cache eviction guard when batcher reduces prefix reuse 3) improve kernel scoring to prefer occupancy on short sequences
kevin: I'll isolate autotuner dataset to include our small-seq tails and re-run tuning. also instrument Triton's choice reasons into the kernel selector logs
eli: put a canary on autoselect with 10% traffic and perf guards (p99 threshold) before global rollout
sandeep: adding an infra playbook note to incidents/ops for kernel-autoselect rollouts (how to flip policy fast)
maria: thanks all. leaving repro + perf dump in /shared/repro/1765004321. ping me if you need access. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll open a follow-up issue with perf traces and add a reference to this thread
jasmin: +1, will pick up KV cache regression follow-up.
perf-bot: ticket created: RED-3412 "Triton autotuner chose suboptimal kernel for small sequences causing p99 regression"
